name: TikTok Token Auto-Refresh
_description: Workflow N8N rieng chay cron 23h/lan de gia han TikTok access_token (het han 24h). Cap nhat credential 'TikTok Open API' tu dong qua N8N REST API.
_setup: 1. Tao credential 'TikTok OAuth Config' kieu HTTP Header Auth co bien moi truong:
- TIKTOK_REFRESH_TOKEN (lay tu OAuth flow lan dau)
2. Tao N8N API key: Settings -> API -> Create Key. Luu vao bien moi truong N8N_API_KEY.
- TIKTOK_CRED_ID = id cua credential 'TikTok Open API' (xem URL credential)
4. Active workflow → cron tu dong chay 23h sau khi save.

nodes.name: Refresh TikTok Token
nodes.notes: POST oauth/token voi grant_type=refresh_token. Response: { access_token, expires_in, refresh_token (rotated) }. LUU Y: TikTok rotate refresh_token moi lan refresh — phai luu refresh_token moi vao env de lan sau dung.

nodes.name: Update TikTok Credential
nodes.notes: PATCH N8N credential voi token moi. PHAI thay 'YOUR_N8N_HOST' va 'TIKTOK_CRED_ID' ID that. Yeu cau N8N API key trong env N8N_API_KEY.

nodes.name: Notify Success
nodes.notes: Goi message ve Telegram chu shop xac nhan. LUU Y: refresh_token rotate moi lan, phai update vao env TIKTOK_REFRESH_TOKEN sau message nay (manual hoac qua workflow phu).
